text: A first-order structure (model) 𝓜 for a signature σ must specify all of the following EXCEPT:
choices: a formal proof of each axiom of the theory
an interpretation of each function symbol as a function on the domain
an interpretation of each relation symbol as a subset of Mⁿ
explanation: A structure consists of a non-empty domain together with interpretations of the constant, function, and relation symbols — it supplies SEMANTICS, not proofs. A formal proof (option 2) belongs to the syntactic/proof-theoretic side, so it is not part of a structure; the other three are exactly what a structure provides.
